productionQualityGate.rationale: Both technology/CS and arts/music materials here are project- and rubric-scored, not fixed-answer-key items — the gate's own type contract treats ARTS_RFL_PE_PROJECT as not requiring instruction/workedExample/guidedPractice blocks, since the activity itself carries the instructional load, and accepts RUBRIC or SCORING_JUDGMENT in place of a fixed ANSWER_KEY.

privacyAndCopyrightPolicy.technology: Every unit's project task and privacy note (presentation_and_privacy.sandbox_and_credentials_note) explicitly prohibits real accounts, real passwords/API keys/credentials, live production systems, and any real external person's data. All examples are fictional or sandboxed.
privacyAndCopyrightPolicy.artsMusic: No unit requires public performance, a voice recording, a camera, or a photo. Every unit states a private/small-audience option (presentation_and_privacy.presentation_options) and a text/no-audio alternative (presentation_and_privacy.text_or_no_audio_alternative). Only original student work, public-domain material, or properly licensed/cited excerpts may be used — no unit asks a student to reproduce unlicensed lyrics or sheet music in full.
privacyAndCopyrightPolicy.authorship: Every task package's copyright_and_authorship field states the graded submission must remain the student's own authorship; adult/AI assistance may support planning, technique, or feedback but must not produce the graded work.
